title: ID0420633-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2 / S9 313882469002] Issue with outlet 1
description:
Reported issue:  Since yesterday we´ve got over 180 alarms in our backend from this charger. On outlet 1 we also noticed it changing to a "faulted" state regularly - but changing back to the state "available" shortly after.
Solution:  Charger is healthy

additional_info.body:
Dear Lara Anna Oblak,
Hope you are doing well.
We have reviewed the reported logs and observed that on DC1, the pilot state changed from B to E, which resulted in an internal error status on the DC1 outlet. Currently, both outlets are available and there are no active error flags on the SCB since 25/04. Please confirm if we can proceed with closing the ticket.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
